name: opentune-mcp
description: Lets AI agents operate OpenTune Standalone, an editor for the pitch and timing of recorded vocals, and reports every result in a clear, structured form.
long_description: OpenTune MCP Server (by Synchain) is a local MCP server. It talks to a build of OpenTune Standalone that has the control interface, over a loopback-only connection; it listens on no network port. Choose that OpenTune executable in the settings below. Run opentune-mcp doctor from a terminal if something does not work.

tools.name: opentune_get_status
tools.description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): reports whether this server can use OpenTune now, as one state (READY, NOT_READY, PROTOCOL_MISMATCH, STARTING, RUNNING_WITHOUT_API, NOT_RUNNING, NO_API_BUILD, NOT_INSTALLED, WSL_UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME) with a nextStep saying who should do what. Call it first, and again whenever a tool error says so. Lists the running instances with their instance_id; when several run, ask the user which one to use. Read-only: it never starts, stops or changes OpenTune.

tools.name: opentune_get_project
tools.description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): reads the open project: path and unsaved-changes flag, tracks (volume, mute, solo), clips with timeline start, end and source file, a summary of each clip content (analysis state, key, note count, pitch shift), the selection and the transport. Every clip carries a clip_revision and the result an arrangement_revision: pass them as expected_revision to write tools. track_ids limits the result to those tracks; include_history adds the undo and redo tops. Read-only.

tools.name: opentune_get_notes
tools.description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): lists the notes of one clip in start-time order, a page at a time (limit default 100, at most 200; fewer when the page would be large). Each note has its index, start and end seconds on the content clock (source audio) and, for a clip placement, on the timeline clock, detected and target MIDI pitch, offset in cents, retune speed (0 natural to 1 mechanical), vibrato and voiced / corrected flags. clock says which clock from and to use; timeline needs a placement id. Read-only.

tools.name: opentune_get_job
tools.description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): reports a long-running job (import, export, analysis, project open or save): state queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled, progress, and when it has ended its result or error. With wait_seconds it waits up to that long for the job to end. Finished jobs are kept for 30 minutes. Read-only.

tools.name: opentune_cancel_job
tools.description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): asks OpenTune to stop a running job and reports the outcome. Work the job already committed stays: an import keeps the items imported so far, and the result lists them with how to revert each; an export never touches the target file. Project saves, preference changes and project opens past their preparation cannot be cancelled; the error then says so and the job continues.

tools.name: opentune_launch
tools.description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): starts the OpenTune build configured for this server (OPENTUNE_MCP_OPENTUNE_PATH) with its control API and waits up to 30 seconds until it is ready, then reports the state like opentune_get_status, with a nextStep. Starts nothing when OpenTune already runs (alreadyRunning), may run without the control API, or no API build is configured; the result says why. Repeated or concurrent calls share one start. allow_second_instance needs the user's explicit consent; each call with it starts one more instance once earlier starts are done. Never closes OpenTune.

tools.name: opentune_open_audio
tools.description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): imports audio files as new clips, as the window does, and waits up to wait_seconds (default 25, max 30); if the import job has not ended, the result names it for opentune_get_job. Give path or items (absolute paths; quotes, file://, ~ and /mnt/<drive>/ are accepted). layout: single, sequential (end to end) or separate_tracks. Not undoable; the result says how to revert. In the openDyne scheme the focused clip also gets notes (no undo entry). Repeating a call with the same files and target returns the earlier result unless allow_duplicate is true.

tools.name: opentune_export_audio
tools.description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): writes a WAV file of a clip, a track or the master mix and waits up to wait_seconds (default 20, max 30); if the export job has not ended, the result names it for opentune_get_job. kind clip needs target.clip (placement id), track needs target.track, master takes none. path: absolute, ending in .wav; default <source folder>/<source name>.opentune.wav. Never overwrites: a taken name gets the next free one. Unanalysed contents are exported uncorrected (dryContents; allow_dry for failed analysis). Does not change the project.

opentune_path.title: OpenTune executable
opentune_path.description: The OpenTune executable to start when needed. Choose a build of OpenTune Standalone that includes the control interface (the file opentune-control.json sits next to it). Leave empty to use only an OpenTune you have already started.
